title: A Scholarship for the Locker
author: Rosalind Thornbury
blurb: Petra Zhou, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
